name: route-tag-patterns-and-crlf
description: CRLF becomes LF before any pattern runs. Two route tag_patterns: <<<(.*?)>>> (flag s) yields its capture group, trimmed; ^FACT: [^\n]+ (flag m) has no group, so the whole match is the block text. Neither block has an id: sys1, sys2. Removing both spans leaves "Answer from the article." and four newlines, which collapse and are trimmed.

messages.content:
Answer from the article.

<<<
Password reset links expire after 15 minutes.
>>>
FACT: Accounts lock after 5 failed attempts.
How long is a reset link valid?
